title: Environment Proxmox facts
description: Schema for <env>/proxmox/proxmox.yaml — single-consumer Proxmox facts moved out of config.yaml (they are consumed only by the Proxmox provider modules). Overrides the provider defaults from providers/proxmox/params.yaml.

network_bridge.description: Proxmox bridge VMs attach to (overrides the provider default, e.g. vmbr0)

storage.description: Storage pool overrides per artifact kind

disks.description: Pool for the OS disk (scsi0) and the cloud-init volume

data_disks.description: Pool for data disks (scsi1 and above); defaults to disks
